With an international audience of nearly 2 million weekly, TIME Magazine Europe covers the key issues and events affecting the region.
Experience TIME Magazine Europe on iPad and iPhone. Subscribe monthly and get 1 week FREE or annually and get 1 month FREE with your subscription. Or purchase individual issues of TIME -including past issues and commemorative issues from the archive.

TIME Magazine subscriptions are available: 1-month subscription £3.99/€4.49/$3.99, 1-year subscription £37.99//€38.99/$42.99.

The TIME Magazine App is free to download and updated with new features. New and current features include:
Mobile-friendly text and image view.
Text to speech audio capability.
Article and page bookmarks for easy access or to save for later.
A personalised reading experience with changeable font size, brightness and theme. 
Previews of each page to find specific articles and use an explore and search function for past and current articles.
Designed for both iPhone and iPad.
Digital issues of TIME include everything in the print edition.
Allows pre-download for reading offline anytime, anywhere.
Current subscribers can sign in with their digital account to access iPad and iPhone app editions.
Subscription Options
• Subscribe monthly or yearly. Or buy single issue(s) through our in-app purchase.
• Your purchase gets you access to both the iPad and iPhone.
• Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscribers can manage their subscription by visiting iTunes Account settings after purchase.
• Subscription rate is in your local currency at the prevailing exchange rate as defined by iTunes.
• Subscribers to the print edition of the magazine get each week’s issue for FREE, after validating their subscription with digital account activation.

TIME is the perfect weekly digest, a trusted source for news that captures the events that shape our lives. Stay in the know with breaking news headlines and informed analysis on everything from politics, business and the economy alongside articles covering health and wellness, the arts, science and technology reviews and more, all accompanied by high quality photos and video content.

TIME’s signature voice and content have made it one of the most recognized international news brands in the world. Offering a rare convergence of incisive reporting, lively writing and world-renowned photography, every issue of TIME delivers a deeper understanding of the world we live in.
Download the app today and enjoy TIME like you’ve never experienced it before.
